{{Quote|There was no one left. Families, friends, every last soul... dead.|Ship recounts the fate of its builders|<ref name="MSW38">[[Star Wars (1977) 38|''Star Wars'' (1977) 38]]</ref>}}
A '''species''' built massive [[mecho-organic vessel]]s, including [[Ship (sentient spacecraft)|Ship]], to fight in an [[Unidentified extra-galactic war|extra-galactic war]]. At the end of this war one faction released a [[plague bomb]]. As far as Ship was aware, this wiped out the entire species.<ref name="MSW38" />
